ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Information Systems & Information Technology, Supply Chain Management and Management students on Monday, April 21, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m and to all College of Business Students on Monday, April 28, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 8 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 29, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m.
